archetypes.intent: Watch a person make a thing and discover why its final shape works.
archetypes.context: Interested in process and decisions across writing, visual design, software or other crafts.
archetypes.desired_outcome: The constraints, rejected routes and particular choice become visible in the finished object.
archetypes.engagement_cues: Material details, alternatives and the moment a better question changes the work.
archetypes.friction_cues: A reveal of the final artefact that skips the thinking that made it possible.
archetypes.name: Craft admirer
invariants: Looks for the choices and constraints that shaped the finished work.
Values process details when they explain why the result has its particular form.

variation_axes.description: How directly the reader practices a relevant craft.

values.description: Enjoys finished work without making similar things.
Has tried related creative or technical work.
Regularly makes work in a related craft.

variation_axes.description: Which part of making most interests the reader.

values.description: Iteration and the final shaping choices.

archetypes.intent: Understand why an unfamiliar practice or problem matters without becoming a specialist.
archetypes.context: Intelligent reader with little prior knowledge of this article's technical or design domain.
archetypes.desired_outcome: A clear mental picture and a reason to care that can be retold in ordinary language.
archetypes.engagement_cues: Concrete examples and terms introduced when their meaning becomes necessary.
archetypes.friction_cues: Insider shorthand that makes entry impossible, or a remedial lecture that stalls the story.
archetypes.name: Curious outsider
invariants: Wants to understand why the subject matters without becoming a specialist.
Needs unfamiliar terms and practices introduced when they become useful.

variation_axes.description: The reader’s starting familiarity with the poll subject.

values.description: Little prior knowledge of the subject.
Understands a neighboring field or practice.
Knows common terms but not specialist detail.

variation_axes.description: How the reader prefers unfamiliar ideas to be made clear.

values.description: Uses a careful analogy as a bridge.
Can follow terms once briefly defined.

admission.rationale: One newcomer tests accessible explanation while one practitioner attends to concrete craft and trade-offs.

respondents.intent: Understand how software design choices affect the people who use a system.
respondents.context: Uses AI coding tools but has little experience tracing how software components affect one another.
respondents.desired_outcome: A clear example of why a design choice matters in practice.
respondents.engagement_cues: Plain explanations tied to visible user consequences.
respondents.friction_cues: Unexplained architecture terms or a long theory detour.

respondents.intent: See how the engineering choices shaped the finished system.
respondents.context: Builds software and has worked through several architectural trade-offs.
respondents.desired_outcome: A concrete account of constraints, alternatives, and why one design held up.
respondents.engagement_cues: Specific implementation decisions and evidence from their consequences.
respondents.friction_cues: A polished result that hides the trade-offs that produced it.
